Chapter 5
Enteral and Parenteral Nutrition Support  87
Fluid and Nutrient Density Many patients, particularly 
those with impaired renal, cardiac, or pulmonary function, are 
unable to tolerate large volumes of ﬂ uid. Th erefore, nutrient 
density is of concern in product selection. Th e nutrient density 
of an enteral formula is measured in kcal per mL, and usually 
ranges between 1.0 and 2.0 kcal
